refuted.message: No primary source for a 3-5x sends:likes weighting was found in any venue searched (Mosseri's accounts, Instagram blog, Meta newsroom, Transparency Center).
refuted.instead: Mosseri (2025-01-21): likes are 'slightly' more important for connected reach, sends 'slightly' more for unconnected. The asymmetry runs both ways and no numeric ratio is published.

refuted.message: Misquotation. Mosseri's 2025-12-31 Threads essay says 'That feed is dead' about personal sharing migrating to DMs, and it is a public essay, not an internal memo.
refuted.instead: He announces NO ranking change and explicitly defers: 'tackling algorithmic transparency and control is probably best left for another essay.'

refuted.message: It is 134 studies reporting 208 effect-size CONTRASTS (Grybinas, Kantner & Dobbins 2019, Memory & Cognition 47:1314-1327). Calling it 208 studies inflates the count ~55%.
refuted.instead: Say '134 studies / 208 contrasts', or drop the number.

refuted.message: The r = 0.26 figure could not be located in the paywalled article, its abstract, Crossref, PubMed, Google Books, or a full-text search across 41 open-access mere-exposure papers. Its proximate source is Wikipedia.
refuted.instead: Make the claim qualitatively: repeated supraliminal visual exposure increases liking, up to a point.

refuted.message: Faithfully reports Bornstein 1989, but later work with proper awareness controls contradicts it (Fox & Burns 1993 'a failure to replicate'; de Zilva et al. 2013: 'the mere exposure effect does not occur without conscious awareness').
refuted.instead: Cite as history, never as mechanism.

refuted.message: No format-keyed favor or penalty state appears in any documented architecture. Retrieval is ANN over item embeddings plus a predicted-value score.
refuted.instead: A real account-level gate exists but is keyed to ORIGINALITY (de-recommends primarily non-original reposting), not to format choice.

folklore.message: The '3-second hook rule' has no peer-reviewed basis. A targeted search returned only content farms, SEO blogs, and platform-vendor marketing.
folklore.instead: Real short-form research is descriptive (Zannettou et al. CHI'24) or recsys-internal; none identifies human-legible creative features.

folklore.message: Volume-as-growth-strategy is unevidenced, and is the specific error the source case study spent two years and 800 posts disproving.
folklore.instead: Format quality and consistency, not cadence. Publish less, with a validated format.

folklore.message: Anthropomorphic framing with no documented referent. There is no per-format punitive state.
folklore.instead: Describe the actual mechanism: predicted-value scoring and retrieval proximity, or say you do not know.

hypothesis_as_fact.message: This mechanism is a HYPOTHESIS. No source establishes that 'format' is a dimension of the learned representation.
hypothesis_as_fact.instead: Label it: 'a plausible mechanism no cited source establishes'. The supported claim is the negative one (no documented format-keyed favor state).

hypothesis_as_fact.message: FALSE MECHANISM. Item embeddings are computed from item content by the item tower; one item's popularity does not move a creator's other item embeddings.
hypothesis_as_fact.instead: Any real effect would run through viewer-side interaction history, which is a different and undocumented mechanism. State it as an open question.

precision_without_source.message: Precise figure with no citation marker within 3 lines. Precision is a rhetorical property, freely available, and does not entail that a measurement occurred.
